privacy.lead: This policy explains what data Puzzled collects, why it is collected, and how to get in touch about it.

cta.body: The Terms of Service cover accounts, subscriptions and conduct. Support helps with account and billing questions.

thirdParty.others: We may also share data with our hosting providers, professional advisers, authorities where the law requires it, and a buyer or successor if our business or Puzzled is sold or reorganised.

security.content: We protect personal data with appropriate technical and organisational measures, but no service is completely secure. If a personal data breach occurs, we notify the Information Commissioner's Office where the law requires, and we tell you directly where the breach is likely to result in a high risk to your rights and freedoms.

terms.lead: These terms set out the rules that apply when you use Puzzled, including accounts, subscriptions and conduct.

Whenever you upload or submit a display name, profile picture, or other content or feedback on Puzzled, you warrant and represent that you own all necessary rights in it or hold a valid licence to submit it and grant the permissions below, and that it does not infringe any third party's intellectual property, privacy, or other rights or violate any law. You give us a worldwide, royalty-free licence to use your display name, profile picture and results to run Puzzled, including leaderboards and shared results, and a perpetual, irrevocable licence to use any feedback you send us. Send all intellectual property or copyright notices exclusively to legal@sylphx.com; customer support channels cannot accept legal or IP notices.

general.content: We may transfer our rights and obligations under these terms to another organisation, for example if Puzzled is sold; we will tell you, and you can cancel if you are unhappy. You may not transfer yours. If a court finds part of these terms unenforceable, the rest stays in force. If we do not enforce a term straight away, we can still enforce it later. Before starting formal court or dispute proceedings against us, you agree to send a written notice describing the dispute and giving us 30 days to cure or resolve it exclusively to legal@sylphx.com (customer support channels cannot accept service of legal notices). Nothing in this pre-action notice step restricts or delays urgent injunctive or equitable relief, action needed to preserve a statutory limitation period, non-waivable statutory consumer remedies, or complaints to the UK Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) or any competent data-protection or consumer regulator. These terms are governed by the law of England and Wales. You can bring a claim in the courts of England and Wales, or in your local courts if you live in Scotland, Northern Ireland or another country, and you keep the protection of the mandatory consumer law of the place you live.
